packages/skills/video-router.description: Compatibility entry for earlier skill installations. Start new work with video-studio.

Review the complete snapshot index and inspect the cover and risky frames at full size before showing a visual preview. Return one complete, actionable repair set without opening another user gate.

packages/skills/design-system-importer.description: Turns reference images, videos, screenshots and brand guides into concrete visual and timing constraints (reproduce, edit or guide).

packages/skills/frontend-design.description: Visual direction for page-rendered video: design presets, type, palette, layout and motion. Read as needed before writing index.html.

packages/skills/orchestration.description: Compatibility entry for multi-source production; use video-studio for current work.

packages/skills/stage-assemble.description: Assemble legacy EDL parts or a current mixed-source video.

packages/skills/stage-consistency.description: Keep recurring characters, props and shot geography consistent across generated shots.

packages/skills/stage-plan.description: Maintain an existing legacy EDL or prepare a user-requested plan.

packages/skills/video-studio.description: Make a whole video from one request: gather material, produce, check and deliver. Read first for a new video or script request.
